pieces.title: It is moving
pieces.caption: A window of colour that drifts from dusk-orange to deep blue over ninety seconds, too slowly to see. Two fixed swatches beside it show where it began and where it is going. *What is real and what is a choice:* Just a slow fade. Whether ninety seconds is slow enough is a guess to tune by eye. *Leaking in:* Seneca, whom the map says he contradicts: the hourglass is Seneca's avatar.
